name: sustambitech-bi
description: SustAmbiTech Eletropostos — Plataforma de Postos de Recarga EV com BI | by Kayham

scripts.dev:local: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --d1=sustambitech-production --local --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
scripts.db:reset:local: rimraf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:schema:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:stats:local: wrangler d1 execute sustambitech-production --local --command="SELECT 'postos' as tabela, COUNT(*) as total FROM postos_recarga UNION SELECT 'conectores', COUNT(*) FROM dim_conectores UNION SELECT 'usuarios', COUNT(*) FROM usuarios UNION SELECT 'avaliacoes', COUNT(*) FROM avaliacoes_postos"
scripts.db:stats:prod: wrangler d1 execute sustambitech-production --command="SELECT 'postos' as tabela, COUNT(*) as total FROM postos_recarga UNION SELECT 'conectores', COUNT(*) FROM dim_conectores UNION SELECT 'usuarios', COUNT(*) FROM usuarios UNION SELECT 'avaliacoes', COUNT(*) FROM avaliacoes_postos"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name sustambitech
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name sustambitech-bi
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
